changelog: ✦ Hardening Lintas Modul: Isolasi Backtest di Jurnal SIM (tidak memengaruhi saldo/loss guard live).
✦ Trader Insights Engine: Evaluasi status sesi market real-time (fail-safe) dan Daily Loss Guard terpadu.
✦ Pemisahan Profil & Pengaturan: Profil fokus akun trader; ikon gerigi untuk pengaturan vertikal HP.
✦ Academy & Media Upgrade: Bookmark materi favorit, Lanjut Baca 1-ketuk, dan filter riwayat tontonan video.
✦ Replay Lab Enhancements: Bookmark momen setup, banner lanjut bulan berikutnya, antrean eksekusi bebas race condition.
